{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ironwithe''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. It was hard as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], yet its shoots were the major part of a giant [[renda bear]]'s diet. Every few decades, an event would be triggered where ironwithe plants would die planet-wide, even affecting ironwithe growth [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]] away.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

It was also a popular export to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] for rooftop gardens.<ref name="MedStar II" />
